content.value_statement: Unused code slows reviews and increases maintenance risk. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code identify removal candidates with review guidance.
actual_capabilities: Identifies unused imports, variables, functions, CSS classes, and type definitions.
Flags unreachable code paths and commented code blocks for review.
Checks dependencies for unused packages and environment mismatches.
Separates safe removals from potentially dynamic or public API usage.
Produces cleanup recommendations with estimated size and line impact.
limitations: Dynamic references may require manual review before removal.
Public exports need owner confirmation to avoid breaking consumers.
Coverage-based findings depend on the quality of available tests.
The skill gives guidance but does not guarantee safe deletion.

use_cases.title: Prepare a cleanup sprint
use_cases.description: Create a prioritized list of unused files, symbols, and dependencies before planned refactoring work.

use_cases.title: Review dependency health
use_cases.description: Find packages that are installed but no longer used, or installed in the wrong dependency group.

use_cases.title: Protect public APIs
use_cases.description: Identify exported functions that look unused internally but may still be part of a public contract.

prompt_templates.title: Basic dead code scan
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a focused review of one project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this repository for dead code. Focus on unused imports, variables, and private functions. Report safe removals first.

prompt_templates.title: Dependency cleanup review
prompt_templates.scenario: Check package usage before removing dependencies.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the dependencies in this project. Find packages that appear unused or misclassified. Explain what evidence supports each recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Safe removal plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a staged cleanup plan for a team.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a safe removal plan for this codebase. Separate obvious dead code from exported symbols and dynamic references that need review.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced monorepo audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Audit a larger codebase with higher risk.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this monorepo for dead code. Combine imports, exports, dependency use, coverage signals, and public API risk. Recommend an ordered cleanup sequence.

output_examples.input: A developer asks for a dead code review of a TypeScript application.
output: A summary of unused imports, variables, functions, and dependencies.
Findings grouped by safe removal, needs review, and potential dynamic usage.
A cleanup order that starts with low-risk items.

output_examples.input: A team lead asks whether old packages can be removed.
output: A dependency review that separates unused packages from misclassified packages.
Evidence for each package based on imports, scripts, and production usage.
Testing notes for validating dependency removal.

output_examples.input: A library maintainer asks about exported functions that are not used internally.
output: A list of exports that need consumer review before removal.
Risk notes for public API compatibility.
A recommendation to deprecate uncertain exports before deletion.

best_practices: Run tests after each cleanup batch to catch hidden references.
Review exported symbols with package owners before deleting them.
Keep dead code removal in focused commits with clear evidence.
anti_patterns: Do not remove public exports only because internal usage is missing.
Do not trust static results when reflection or string-based calls are common.
Do not combine large refactors with dead code deletion in one change.

faq.question: Can this skill remove code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It identifies removal candidates and gives guidance. A developer should review changes and run tests.

faq.question: Does it support TypeScript projects?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes guidance for unused imports, exports, types, interfaces, and TypeScript-specific cleanup tools.

faq.question: How does it handle public APIs?
faq.answer: It treats public exports conservatively. These findings are marked for review because external consumers may still depend on them.

faq.question: Can it find unused dependencies?
faq.answer: Yes. It reviews installed packages, import usage, and dependency placement across production and development groups.

faq.question: Will it detect dynamically used code?
faq.answer: It can flag possible dynamic usage, but manual review is required for reflection, plugin loading, and string references.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
